name: Paddle MCP Server
summary: Paddle's official MCP server for Paddle Billing: manage products, prices, customers, subscriptions, transactions, refunds and reports.
description: Paddle now documents a hosted server: https://mcp.paddle.com/mcp (live; OAuth since 2026-08-04, or a live API key) and https://sandbox-mcp.paddle.com/mcp (sandbox; API key only). The hosted server uses codemode with three tools (search, execute, report_missing_tool); OAuth connections start with read access within your Paddle role, and destructive calls carry destructiveHint plus a warning. The open-source local server (`npx -y @paddle/paddle-mcp`, PADDLE_API_KEY and PADDLE_ENVIRONMENT) exposes 90 tools and filters them with `--tools` or PADDLE_MCP_TOOLS: all, read-only, non-destructive or a comma-separated list. The default is non-destructive, which drops only update/delete tools, so it still loads create tools such as create_transaction, create_adjustment and create_subscription_charge: 70 tools in production, 63 in sandbox (the 7 metrics tools are skipped there). read-only loads 48 (41 in sandbox). The local server reports serverInfo version 0.1.3 (hardcoded) although npm `@paddle/paddle-mcp` is 0.1.6. Paddle Billing only, not Paddle Classic. Paddle is a merchant of record. Apache-2.0.

agent_access.notes: Live: OAuth or Bearer live API key. Sandbox: https://sandbox-mcp.paddle.com/mcp with Bearer sandbox API key. Local package: PADDLE_API_KEY plus PADDLE_ENVIRONMENT=sandbox|production.
